mapper.sql:
JOIN CHALLENGE ch ON f.chal_code = ch.code
JOIN ( SELECT m.code, m.id, i.path, m.ranking, m.rating FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m LEFT JOIN IMAGES i ON m.code = i.target_code AND i.TYPE = 'profile' ) AS mp ON mp.code = f.mem_code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fl.feed_code, count(*) AS cnt FROM FEED_LIKE fl GROUP BY fl.feed_code ) AS cnt_like ON cnt_like.feed_code = f.code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.feed_code, count(*) AS cnt FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.delete_yn = 0 AND c.status = 'active' GROUP BY c.feed_code ) AS cnt_comment ON cnt_comment.feed_code = f.code
LEFT JOIN FEED_LIKE my_like ON my_like.feed_code = f.code AND my_like.mem_code = #{memberCode}

f.code, f.title, f.hitcount, f.created_at, f.updated_at, ch.title AS challenge_name, mp.code AS m_code, mp.id AS m_id, mp.ranking AS m_ranking, mp.rating AS m_rating, mp.path AS m_profile_image, fh.tag_name AS hashtags, IFNULL(cnt_comment.cnt, 0) AS count_feed_comment, IFNULL(cnt_like.cnt, 0) AS count_feed_like, IF(my_like.feed_code IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS liked_yn
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM FEED f WHERE f.status = 'active' AND f.delete_yn = 0

SELECT , f.content, i.path AS image_paths FROM FEED f
LEFT JOIN IMAGES i ON f.code = i.target_code AND i.type = 'feed'
LEFT JOIN FEED_HASHTAG fh ON f.code = fh.feed_code WHERE f.code = #{feedCode} ORDER BY i.order_seq ASC

SELECT f.code, f.chal_code, f.title, f.content, fh.tag_name AS hashtags, i.path AS image_paths FROM FEED AS f LEFT JOIN IMAGES i ON f.code = i.target_code AND i.type = 'feed' LEFT JOIN FEED_HASHTAG fh ON f.code = fh.feed_code WHERE f.code = #{feedCode} AND f.mem_code = #{memberCode}
